title: Food package declares a best-before, use-by or expiry date
plain: Food says how long it keeps
plain_action: Confirm the product category, then look for a best-before, use-by or expiry date on the pack.

citation.clause: Rule 6(1)(d) referral; FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, reg. 5(10) and 8
citation.text: A prepackaged food carries a date of expiry, best-before or use-by declaration under its own labelling regime, which the packaged commodities date rule refers to rather than replaces. Screening for the presence of such a declaration on a confirmed food package only; shelf-life, surface-area and small-package exemptions are not decided here, and this is not a food-law determination.

messages.pass: A best-before, use-by or expiry declaration was found on this food package.
messages.violation: No best-before, use-by or expiry declaration was found on this food package.
messages.inconclusive: Confirm the product category, and capture every printed face before treating a best-before declaration as absent. A best-before duty is decided under food labelling law, not by this general packaged-commodities screen.
